ja395:1.1: Cirassaṃ vata passāma sahāyaṃ maṇidhārinaṃ, sukatāya massukuttiyā sobhate vata me sakhā ti.
ja395:2.1: Parūḷhakacchanakhalomo ahaṃ kamme suvyāvaṭo cirassaṃ nahāpitaṃ laddhā lomantam apahārayin ti.
ja395:3.1: Yan nu lomaṃ ahāresi dullabhaṃ laddhu kappakaṃ atha kiñ carahi te samma kaṇṭhe kiṇakiṇāyatīti.
ja395:4.1: Manussasukhumālānaṃ maṇi kaṇṭhesu lambati, tes' āhaṃ anusikkhāmi, mā tvaṃ maññi davā kataṃ.
ja395:5.1: Sace p' imaṃ pihayasi massukuttiṃ sukāritaṃ kārayissāmi te samma maṇiñ cāpi dadāmi te
ja395:6.1: ti. Tvañ ñeva maṇino channo sukatāya ca massuyā, āmanta kho taṃ gacchāmi, piyaṃ me tav' adassanan ti.
